decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several high-rated options, particularly the QT&QY 45L Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) which has excellent reviews and value. However, the overall product selection is heavily focused on specialized niches: either military-style tactical gear with MOLLE webbing, technical internal-frame hiking packs for multi-day trips (High Sierra and Mardingtop), or sport-specific bags (baseball, ski boots). As I was looking for a more versatile, everyday-carry backpack for standard commuting or urban travel, the rugged aesthetics and specialized features of the military and technical outdoor gear provided do not quite match my requirements for a casual daily bag.
